subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-10-08
html:
Rank stayed flat for a 15th straight week (0 of 22 tracked keywords, avg position 100; backlinks flat 3/2 referring domains since 09-10) and a fresh 10-term keyword pull found nothing new — the FOCUS cluster, connector matrix, and comparison hub all remain exhausted against current demand. So this session did a closer read of the actual <head> HTML on every static page (not audit prose) and found a real, previously unflagged bug class: a clone-and-forget-to-rename copy-paste artifact.

PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
/about, /blog, /contact, /pricing + the shared base-template every new page is cloned fromAll four live pages (plus the template) had their og:title/og:description/twitter:title/twitter:description and JSON-LD WebPage block hardcoded to a different page's content (\"ARLO for SEO Specialists\", describing Search Console/PageSpeed/GBP, URL pointing at the homepage). Social shares of these links showed the wrong preview card, and each page's own structured data mis-described itself to crawlers. Rewrote each page's OG/Twitter tags and JSON-LD WebPage/breadcrumb to describe itself correctly; replaced the template's copy with obvious REPLACE-ME placeholders so the bug can't silently propagate into the next cloned page.N/A — on-page/schema correctness fixaskarlo.app/pricing — view page source, check og:title and the first JSON-LD script tag
All 5 live /compare/[slug] pages (Windsor.ai, Supermetrics, AgencyAnalytics, Whatagraph, Funnel.io vs ARLO — the comparison hub)Each page's route already builds a correct, dynamic WebPage+FAQPage+Breadcrumb schema per competitor and injects it properly — confirmed still working. But the shared shell template also hardcoded a second, static WebPage block with the same wrong \"SEO Specialists\" content, so every comparison page was emitting two contradictory WebPage entities for the same URL. Removed the dead duplicate; the correct per-page schema is untouched.supermetrics alternative, agencyanalytics alternative, whatagraph alternative (the comparison hub's core keywords)askarlo.app/compare/supermetrics-vs-arlo — view page source, confirm only one WebPage JSON-LD block
/pricingClosed a gap flagged all the way back in the original 2026-07-04 audit (P0 #5): the page's SoftwareApplication schema only listed a single generic \"$0 Offer\". Replaced it with an AggregateOffer listing all 6 real pricing tiers (Free/Solo/Studio/Agency/Scale/Enterprise, $0–$499/mo).client reporting tool, marketing agency reportingaskarlo.app/pricing — view page source, check the offers array inside the SoftwareApplication JSON-LD

Rankings/backlinks (fresh pull): avg position still flat at 100 (0 of 22 tracked keywords ranked) every day this week — 15th straight week unchanged since kickoff. Backlinks holding at 3/2 referring domains, unchanged since 2026-09-10. GitHub Actions: 48/48 all-time green. catalog.ts's 9 gated connectors and the destinations catalog (power_bi/excel/snowflake past due, shareable_dashboard due this month) all unchanged — no status flip yet.

Next: the remaining static page templates were spot-checked for this exact bug and came up clean, but weren't given the same full head-to-head audit — worth a dedicated pass to see if the same clone-and-forget pattern shows up elsewhere. src/lib/schema.ts's unused generateSchema() function remains dead code (same finding as 2026-09-14), still a human call on delete vs. wire in. Everything that actually moves rank — GSC sitemap submission, off-page Phase 1 (0/6), a connector shipping before its ETA — remains human-gated and unchanged.
